name: EX-07 Combined Arms Manoeuvre — 3 Days
description: 3-day combined arms manoeuvre exercise. Days 1–2 are around-the-clock; Day 3 (wrap-up) is working hours. Covers the full find-fix-finish-exploit cycle with fire support coordination, night operations, and combined arms integration. Rich event set showing how a realistic field exercise is structured.

locks.reason: Fire support exclusion zone — D1 night safety window, coordinate before resuming
Fire support exclusion zone — D2 night safety window

items.title: STARTEX
items.description: Exercise commences. All elements confirm readiness. Synthetic time activated at Day 1 0800.

items.title: Commander's Briefing
items.description: Commander delivers the mission brief. Covers: mission analysis, commander's intent, scheme of manoeuvre, and task org.

items.title: Fire Support Coordination Meeting
items.description: FSCM meeting. Fire support officer, air element, and ground commanders align on fire support plan, targets, and coordination measures.

items.title: Phase 1 Orders Distribution
items.description: Staff distribute Phase 1 orders to all element commanders. Confirm receipt. Questions period.

items.title: Physical: TAA Activation
items.description: Physical meeting at the Tactical Assembly Area. All sub-unit commanders confirm vehicle loads, personnel, ammunition states.

items.title: Intel: Enemy Order of Battle
items.description: Intelligence officer briefs the enemy order of battle: known positions, capabilities, likely courses of action.

items.title: INJECT: Advance Begins
items.description: Lead elements begin advance to contact. All units in march order. Air cover overhead.

items.title: INJECT: Contact Alpha
items.description: Lead element reports contact with enemy forward positions. Small arms fire. Grid reference provided. QRF elements on standby.

items.title: Fire Mission Request
items.description: Forward observer calls fire mission. Target: enemy forward position. Method: observed fire. Authorization from commander required.

items.title: SITREP D1 1400
items.description: Afternoon situation report. Lead element contact report, fire mission status, manoeuvre plan update.

items.title: Decision: Commit Reserve
items.description: Commander decides whether to commit the reserve to exploit the contact or hold and continue main advance.

items.title: Physical: Commanders Update D1
items.description: Command Post briefing. Commanders update the battle picture on the map board. Next phase tasking issued.

items.title: Night Navigation Exercise
items.description: Elements conduct night navigation to Phase 2 forming-up positions. No lights, comms-limited movement.

items.title: SITREP D1 0000
items.description: Midnight report. All elements confirm position, readiness for Phase 2, and any equipment issues.

items.title: Night Fire Support Activity
items.description: Night fire missions to suppress enemy positions ahead of Phase 2. Illumination rounds to support FUP occupation.

items.title: SITREP D2 0400
items.description: Pre-dawn report. Elements confirm FUP positions occupied, ready for Phase 2 H-Hour.

items.title: Physical: Morning Sync D2
items.description: Main CP morning synchronization. Phase 2 orders, fire support update, air support tasking.

items.title: Phase 2 Orders Group
items.description: Full orders for Phase 2 Breach. Sub-unit tasks, lanes, breach points, phase lines, and ROE.

items.title: INJECT: Breach Phase Alpha
items.description: Breach begins on Phase Alpha axis. Lead elements engage obstacle complex. Engineers forward.

items.title: INJECT: Breach Phase Bravo
items.description: Bravo axis breach commences. Deception operation on the flanks. Fire support active.

items.title: SITREP D2 1200
items.description: Phase 2 midpoint report. Breach progress on both axes, obstacle status, casualties, ammo consumption.

items.title: Exploitation Phase
items.description: Exploitation of breach success. Armoured elements pass through breached obstacle. Follow-on forces advance.

items.title: Decision: Pursue or Consolidate
items.description: Commander decides: pursue the enemy or consolidate the objective. Assessment of enemy strength and own logistics required.

items.title: Physical: Update D2 Evening
items.description: CP evening update. Map updated with exploitation results. Logistics resupply plan coordinated.

items.title: SITREP D2 2000
items.description: Evening D2 comprehensive report. Objective status, forward element positions, log state.

items.title: Night Consolidation
items.description: All-round defence. Elements consolidate on objectives. Re-org, casualty collection, prisoner handling, resupply.

items.title: SITREP D3 0400
items.description: Pre-dawn D3 report. Overnight consolidation status, readiness for ENDEX phase.

items.title: Physical: Morning Brief D3
items.description: D3 Main CP morning brief. Transition to consolidation and ENDEX phase.

items.title: Consolidation Activity D3
items.description: Final consolidation. Admin, casualty reports, log reconciliation, lessons observed capture.

items.title: Final SITREP
items.description: Exercise final situation report. All elements confirm end state. Compare to planned objectives.

items.title: After Action Review
items.description: Full 3-day AAR. Commander's assessment, element reports, fire support review, lessons identified.

items.title: Lessons Observed Report
items.description: Exercise director compiles the formal lessons observed report. Submitted to higher command for action.

items.title: ENDEX
items.description: 3-day combined arms exercise concluded. Synthetic time deactivated.
